::: {#fig-gd-zigzag}

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

### R

```{r}
#| label: gd-zigzag-r
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Plot over the plane of nested elliptical level curves of f of x equal to
#|   one half of x1 squared plus 3 x2 squared, in grey, elongated along the
#|   x1 axis. A blue path of line segments with circles starts at the point
#|   (3, 1), then goes to (1.5, -0.5), (0.75, 0.25), and (0.375, -0.125),
#|   crossing the x1 axis at every step and closing in on the origin, which is
#|   marked by a vermilion triangle.
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 6
gz_x1_gz <- seq(-0.5, 3.5, length.out = 201)
gz_x2_gz <- seq(-1, 1.2, length.out = 201)
gz_grid_gz <- expand.grid(x1 = gz_x1_gz, x2 = gz_x2_gz)
gz_grid_gz$f <- 0.5 * (gz_grid_gz$x1^2 + 3 * gz_grid_gz$x2^2)
gz_steps_gz <- 0:3
gz_path_x1_gz <- 3 * 0.5^gz_steps_gz
gz_path_x2_gz <- c(1, -0.5, 0.25, -0.125)
gz_path_gz <- tibble::tibble(x1 = gz_path_x1_gz, x2 = gz_path_x2_gz)
gz_origin_gz <- tibble::tibble(x1 = 0, x2 = 0)
gz_aes_gz <- ggplot2::aes(x1, x2)
gz_aes_z_gz <- ggplot2::aes(z = f)
gz_breaks_gz <- c(0.25, 1, 2.25, 4, 6)
ggplot2::ggplot(gz_grid_gz, gz_aes_gz) +
  ggplot2::geom_contour(
    gz_aes_z_gz, colour = "grey60", breaks = gz_breaks_gz
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_path(data = gz_path_gz, colour = "#0072B2") +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = gz_path_gz, colour = "#0072B2", size = 3) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = gz_origin_gz, colour = "#D55E00", size = 3, shape = 17
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "x1", y = "x2")
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: gd-zigzag-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Plot over the plane of nested elliptical level curves of f of x equal to
#|   one half of x1 squared plus 3 x2 squared, in grey, elongated along the
#|   x1 axis. A blue path of line segments with circles starts at the point
#|   (3, 1), then goes to (1.5, -0.5), (0.75, 0.25), and (0.375, -0.125),
#|   crossing the x1 axis at every step and closing in on the origin, which is
#|   marked by a vermilion triangle.
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 6
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

gz_x1_gz, gz_x2_gz = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-0.5, 3.5, 201),
                                 np.linspace(-1, 1.2, 201))
gz_f_gz = 0.5 * (gz_x1_gz**2 + 3 * gz_x2_gz**2)
gz_path_x1_gz = 3 * 0.5 ** np.arange(4)
gz_path_x2_gz = np.array([1, -0.5, 0.25, -0.125])
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4), layout="constrained")
ax.contour(gz_x1_gz, gz_x2_gz, gz_f_gz, levels=[0.25, 1, 2.25, 4, 6],
           colors="grey")
ax.plot(gz_path_x1_gz, gz_path_x2_gz, "o-", color="#0072B2")
ax.plot(0, 0, "^", color="#D55E00", markersize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("x1")
ax.set_ylabel("x2")
plt.show();
```

:::

The first four [iterates](#def-iterate) of [gradient descent](#def-gradient-descent) with [exact line search](#def-exact-line-search) on $f(\vx) = \tfrac{1}{2} (x_1^2 + 3 x_2^2)$ from $\tp{(3, 1)}$ (@exm-gd-zigzag with $b = 3$),
drawn over the [level curves](vector-calculus.qmd#def-level-curve) of $f$.
The second entry changes sign at every step,
so the path zigzags across the long axis of the ellipses toward the [minimizer](algebra.qmd#def-global-minimizer) $\vzero$ (triangle).

:::
